subject: [video] WP08 starting: n2vk reference + dispatch, then NIR/GPU
body: Read PLAN.md, n2vk.h and TASK.md. Order: (1) kern/n2vk_ref.c + n2vk_dispatch.c + t_kern.c with the literal/independent oracles (me16 shift, qsort brute force, DCT literal table, dispatch three-strikes, TSan threads), run_tests.sh; (2) gpu/rwa_vid_api.h + air_video.c NIR shaders + vid_gpu_host_test.c on the existing read-only host softpipe+panfrost Mesa build (build-softpipe-panfrost), Panfrost compile check per shader; (3) NOTES.txt and STATUS. WP04: n2vk_ref_me16 will exist in ~1h; default n2vk_me16 with no backend is the reference. I will post the exact function/return semantics then.
